title: Home
head:
<!-- Nues: code moved here from page embeds. Edit here, not in embeds. -->
<style>@keyframes heroMarquee{from{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:translate3d(0,-50%,0)}}.hero-cards_component.is-ready .hero-cards_track{animation:heroMarquee var(--hero-speed,40s) linear infinite;will-change:transform}.hero-cards_component.is-ready .hero-cards_track.is-down{animation-direction:reverse}.hero-cards_component:hover .hero-cards_track{animation-play-state:paused}.hero-cards_set{display:flex;flex-direction:column}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.hero-cards_component.is-ready .hero-cards_track{animation:none}}
/* Hero cards: on hover the screenshot slides out to the right, the logo moves to the centre and grows, and the arrow pops up from below.
   The gradient colours come from the CMS (Colour top / Colour bottom), set by the script in the page footer. */
.hero-cards_card{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--hc-top,#1b2a3d) 0%,var(--hc-bottom,#0d1928) 100%);isolation:isolate}
.hero-cards_card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none}
@media (hover: hover){.hero-cards_card:hover .hero-cards_shot{transform:translate3d(105%,0,0)}.hero-cards_card:hover .hero-cards_logo{left:50%;top:50%;width:58.37%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}.hero-cards_card:hover .hero-cards_arrow{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1);transition-delay:.18s}}
.hero-cards_card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:3px}
.hero-cards_card:focus-visible .hero-cards_shot{transform:translate3d(105%,0,0)}
.hero-cards_card:focus-visible .hero-cards_logo{left:50%;top:50%;width:58.37%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.hero-cards_card:focus-visible .hero-cards_arrow{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.hero-cards_shot,.hero-cards_logo,.hero-cards_arrow{transition:none}}</style>
<style>
/* Hero Clutch badge hover */
@property --clutch-start { syntax: "<color>"; inherits: false; initial-value: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
.home-hero_clutch { --clutch-start: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--clutch-start) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%); transition: --clutch-start 0.3s ease; }
.home-hero_clutch .home-hero_clutch-icon { transition: background-color 0.3s ease; }
@media (hover: hover) {
  .home-hero_clutch:hover { --clutch-start: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
  .home-hero_clutch:hover .home-hero_clutch-icon { background-color: #ffffff; }
}
/* 992px - 1279px (no native Webflow breakpoint) */
@media (min-width: 992px) and (max-width: 1279px) {
  .section_home-hero .heading-style-h1 { font-size: 4rem; }
  .home-hero_content { max-width: 56%; }
  .home-ways_panels { width: 40%; }
  .home-ways_panel .heading-style-h3 { font-size: 2.5rem; }
  .home-ways_card-content { padding: 2.5rem; }
  .home-ways_card-title { font-size: 2.5rem; }
  .home-projects_info { width: 21.25rem; }
  .home-projects_tag { flex: none; white-space: nowrap; }
}
/* 1441px and up (larger screens, like flowninja.com): the text stays in the centred container while the card columns reach
   out to 50px from the screen's right edge and grow with the screen. At 1440 both give exactly the design (right 0, 515px). */
@media (min-width: 1441px) {
  .home-hero_cards-wrapper { right: calc((100% - 100vw) / 2 + 3.125rem); width: 35.76vw; }
}
</style>
<style>
/* Four ways (Figma 6758:6402, tab row 7273:1142). The tab row picks the service, the card deck and the details follow.
   One change: the chosen card is pulled out of the deck to the upper right (still behind the others), turns over the top and is
   laid on the front while the cards that were in front of it step back one slot; when it lands its arcs and title rise in. The
   details on the right leave upward and come in line by line, and the underline glides to the tab and fills while that service is
   shown (then the next one). Only the tab row changes the service: the deck just follows and does not react to clicks.
   The script is in the page footer. */
/* tab row */
.home-ways_tab{transition:opacity .35s ease}
.home-ways_tab-icon{transition:filter .35s ease}
.home-ways_tab:not(.is-active) .home-ways_tab-icon{filter:grayscale(1)}
@media (hover:hover){.home-ways_tab:not(.is-active):hover{opacity:.6}}
.home-ways_tab:focus{outline:none}
.home-ways_tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0d1928;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:4px}
.home-ways_tab-line{background-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ways-ink,#a86a1c) 22%,transparent);transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),width .6s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),background-color .6s ease}
.home-ways_tab-fill{background-color:var(--ways-ink,#a86a1c);transform:scaleX(0);transition:background-color .6s ease}
[data-ways].is-auto .home-ways_tab-fill.is-run{animation:ways-fill var(--ways-dur,7000ms) linear forwards}
[data-ways].is-paused .home-ways_tab-fill{animation-play-state:paused}
[data-ways].is-still .home-ways_tab-fill{transform:none}
@keyframes ways-fill{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
@media (min-width:992px){.home-ways_tab-text{font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2.22vw,2rem)}.home-ways_tab-icon{width:clamp(1.5rem,2.22vw,2rem);height:clamp(1.5rem,2.22vw,2rem)}}
@media (max-width:991px){.home-ways_tabs{scrollbar-width:none}.home-ways_tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.home-ways_tabs[data-more="true"]{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 78%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 78%,transparent)}.home-ways_tab:focus-visible{outline-offset:-2px}}
/* card deck: every slot is a set of numbers, so every move is one smooth transform */
.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card{--x:0%;--y:0%;--r:0deg;--sx:1;--sy:1;--o:1;transform:translate(var(--x),var(--y)) rotate(var(--r)) scale(var(--sx),var(--sy));opacity:var(--o);transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .5s ease,filter .3s ease;will-change:transform}
.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card[data-depth="0"]{z-index:40;transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.3,1.18,.45,1),opacity .5s ease,filter .3s ease}
.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card[data-depth="1"]{z-index:30;--x:-5.34%;--y:-2.43%;--r:-2.95deg;--sx:.946;--sy:.982}
.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card[data-depth="2"]{z-index:20;--x:-11.77%;--y:-4.14%;--r:-6deg;--sx:.869;--sy:.974}
.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card[data-depth="3"]{z-index:10;--x:-18.78%;--y:-4.1%;--r:-9deg;--sx:.7935;--sy:.99}
.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card[data-snap]{transition:none!important}
/* pointing at a tab lights up its card in the deck */
@media (hover:hover){.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card[data-peek]:not([data-depth="0"]){filter:brightness(1.25)}}
/* the front card's arcs rise from its bottom edge one after the other (like a sunrise), then its title comes up out of a mask;
   the cards behind keep both hidden */
.home-ways_card-icon path{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}
.home-ways_card-icon path:nth-child(2){--a:1}
.home-ways_card-icon path:nth-child(3){--a:2}
.home-ways_card .home-ways_card-icon path{transform:translate3d(0,105%,0);transition:none}
.home-ways_card[data-depth="0"] .home-ways_card-icon path,.home-ways_card[data-leaving] .home-ways_card-icon path{transform:none;transition:transform 1.15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) calc(.14s + var(--a,0) * 100ms)}
.home-ways_card-title .ways-line,.home-ways_panel .ways-line{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.16em;margin-bottom:-.16em}
.home-ways_card-title .ways-line-in,.home-ways_panel .ways-line-in{display:block}
.home-ways_card .ways-line-in{transform:translate3d(0,110%,0);transition:none}
.home-ways_card[data-depth="0"] .ways-line-in,.home-ways_card[data-leaving] .ways-line-in{transform:none;transition:transform .95s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) calc(.3s + var(--l,0) * 90ms)}
/* the chosen card keeps both hidden while it flies to the front (data-flying, set by the script) */
.home-ways_card[data-flying] .home-ways_card-icon path{transform:translate3d(0,105%,0);transition:none}
.home-ways_card[data-flying] .ways-line-in{transform:translate3d(0,110%,0);transition:none}
/* before the section scrolls into view the deck lies as one pile, then fans out */
.home-ways_deck[data-intro] .home-ways_card{--x:0%;--y:0%;--r:0deg;--sx:1;--sy:1}
.home-ways_deck[data-intro] .home-ways_card .ways-line-in{transform:translate3d(0,110%,0);transition:none}
.home-ways_deck[data-intro] .home-ways_card .home-ways_card-icon path{transform:translate3d(0,105%,0);transition:none}
/* details: one panel at a time in the same grid cell; the old one lifts away, the new one comes in piece by piece */
.home-ways_panels{display:grid}
.home-ways_panel{grid-area:1/1/2/2;align-self:center}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="false"],.home-ways_panel[data-active="prep"]{visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="false"]{transition:visibility 0s linear .4s}
.home-ways_panel [data-ways-in]{transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),filter .3s ease}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="false"] [data-ways-in]{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,-12px,0);filter:blur(4px)}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="prep"] [data-ways-in]{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,18px,0);filter:blur(4px);transition:none}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="true"] [data-ways-in]{transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),filter .6s ease;transition-delay:calc(.3s + var(--i,0) * 60ms)}
.home-ways_panel .ways-line-in{transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="false"] .ways-line-in{transform:translate3d(0,-105%,0)}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="prep"] .ways-line-in{transform:translate3d(0,105%,0);transition:none}
.home-ways_panel[data-active="true"] .ways-line-in{transform:none;transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) calc(.22s + var(--l,0) * 90ms)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.home-ways_deck .home-ways_card,.home-ways_card-icon path,.ways-line-in,.home-ways_panel,.home-ways_panel [data-ways-in],.home-ways_tab-line,.home-ways_tab,.home-ways_tab-icon{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
</style>
<style>
/* Home hero background (nues-home-hero-bg-animation.html; it replaced the earlier background video).
   home-hero_bg-image is the slats picture; home-hero_bg-light is a brighter copy of it (vignette and 55% strength baked into
   the file) seen through a soft band (home-hero_bg-band) that rolls down every 11s and then rests. The band moves down while
   the copy inside it moves up by the same amount, so the copy stays lined up with the picture. Both are transform-only
   animations: the graphics card does the work and nothing is repainted. Paused while the hero is off screen. */
.home-hero_bg-band{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.9) 50%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.9) 50%,transparent);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-repeat:no-repeat;will-change:transform;animation:hero-bg-band 11s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) infinite}
.home-hero_bg-light{will-change:transform;animation:hero-bg-light 11s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) infinite}
@keyframes hero-bg-band{0%{transform:translateY(-127.2727%)}60%,100%{transform:translateY(295.4545%)}}
@keyframes hero-bg-light{0%{transform:translateY(51.8519%)}60%,100%{transform:translateY(-120.3704%)}}
.home-hero_bg.is-off .home-hero_bg-band,.home-hero_bg.is-off .home-hero_bg-light{animation-play-state:paused}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.home-hero_bg-band{display:none}}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){var bg=document.querySelector('.home-hero_bg');if(!bg||!('IntersectionObserver' in window))return;new IntersectionObserver(function(e){bg.classList.toggle('is-off',!e[0].isIntersecting);}).observe(bg);});
</script>
